toegepas.na: het vir 'n loon by die VOC aangesluit
toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans 'aansluit' normally needs 'by' and an object; the bare form reads like English 'signed on', and the VOC is already named in the sentence.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'het aangesluit' leaves 'joined what?' hanging; Afrikaans 'aansluit' naturally takes 'by' and an object.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'by die VOC' completes the verb without adding a fact (the VOC is already named) and leaves the protected 'meestal arm' intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
laat_vaar.voor: seemanne aan diens op die dek
laat_vaar.na: seemanne op die dek aan diens
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The predicate-like phrase 'aan diens' sits more naturally at the end, after the place phrase.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Lateral word-order move; 'seemanne aan diens op die dek' already reads naturally and the proposal is merely different.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'ná 'n ruk' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; 'ná 'n tyd' is a calque of 'after a time'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'ná 'n tyd' is ordinary Afrikaans, not a calque, and 'ná 'n ruk' can suggest a shorter while, so the swap is lateral at best and risks shifting the time sense.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die dissipline aan boord was hard.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die dissipline aan boord was streng.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Harde dissipline' is good Afrikaans and carries harshness, while 'streng' narrows it to strictness, so the meaning would move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'droog gepak' reads as 'packed dry'; 'gedroog' says the food was dried, parallel to 'gesout'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'droog of gesout gepak' reads naturally, and 'gedroog' narrows it to food that was dried, which does not fit hard biscuit as well as 'droog' does.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'die volgende' without a noun is elliptical; naming 'groep' makes the reference clear in an entry read on its own.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die volgende' clearly points back to ''n groep seemanne' in the same sentence, so the entry stands on its own, and a glossary definition should not be reworded for a lateral gain.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: Op een en dieselfde skip het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Op een skip' can be read as 'on one particular ship'; 'een en dieselfde' makes clear that men from many countries worked together on a single ship.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Op een skip' already reads naturally as 'on a single ship' after the opening sentence, and 'een en dieselfde' only makes the sentence heavier for a Grade 6 reader.
